contract: fp1 schema fingerprint: canonical document, entry hashes and fingerprint per PostgreSQL major
notes: Each vector builds a fresh database on a server of input.pgMajor whose superuser is input.superuser: input.roles run once in the cluster (idempotent), input.setup runs in the new database as the superuser, then an observer snapshot with the managed scope input.scope (includeSchemas, excludeSchemas) must yield exactly expected.document and expected.fingerprint. entry.hash = hex SHA-256 of JCS({class, key, attributes}); fingerprint = "fp1:" + pgMajor + ":" + hex SHA-256 of JCS({header: {canonicalizer, pgMajor, scope: {include, exclude}}, entries: [[class, key, hash], ...]}); documentation digests are stored beside entries and hashed nowhere. Documents were produced by the Wave 4 introspection on PostgreSQL 16, 17 and 18 and reviewed by hand against schema-fingerprints.md section 3; every hash, the fingerprint, the sort order and the omission rules were re-derived by an independent Python script written from the specification. A role literally named "PUBLIC" exists in fp1-007 to fp1-009 and fp1-015: the PUBLIC pseudo-role is null in a policy's roles and has no "to" in an ACL entry, so the two never meet. Append-only once the owner accepts G4; a corrected canonicalizer is fp2.

vectors.description: complex, PostgreSQL 16: enum, domain, composite type, owned sequence, identity and generated columns, foreign key, NOT VALID check, partial covering and NULLS NOT DISTINCT indexes, range partitions, security_invoker view, materialized view, SQL and PL/pgSQL functions, trigger with WHEN, extended statistics, comments and rows (neither is structure)

setup: CREATE SCHEMA shop
CREATE TYPE shop.order_state AS ENUM ('new', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')
CREATE DOMAIN shop.positive_amount AS numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT positive CHECK (VALUE > 0)
CREATE TYPE shop.address AS (street text, city text, postal_code varchar(10))
CREATE SEQUENCE shop.invoice_numbers AS integer START 1000 INCREMENT 5 MINVALUE 1000 MAXVALUE 999999 CACHE 10

CREATE TABLE shop.customers (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, email text NOT NULL UNIQUE, shipping shop.address, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), email_domain text GENERATED ALWAYS AS (split_part(email, '@', 2)) STORED)

CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, customer_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES shop.customers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, state shop.order_state NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new', total shop.positive_amount, invoice_number integer DEFAULT nextval('shop.invoice_numbers'), placed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
ALTER TABLE shop.orders ADD CONSTRAINT orders_total_cap CHECK (total < 1000000) NOT VALID
ALTER SEQUENCE shop.invoice_numbers OWNED BY shop.orders.invoice_number
CREATE INDEX orders_open_idx ON shop.orders (customer_id, placed_at DESC) INCLUDE (state) WHERE state <> 'cancelled'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_invoice_idx ON shop.orders (invoice_number) NULLS NOT DISTINCT
CREATE TABLE shop.events (id bigint NOT NULL, happened_on date NOT NULL, payload jsonb) PARTITION BY RANGE (happened_on)
CREATE TABLE shop.events_2026 PARTITION OF shop.events FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-01-01') TO ('2027-01-01')
CREATE VIEW shop.open_orders WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.total FROM shop.orders o WHERE o.state IN ('new', 'paid')
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW shop.customer_totals AS SELECT customer_id, sum(total) AS total FROM shop.orders GROUP BY customer_id WITH NO DATA
CREATE FUNCTION shop.order_total(p_order bigint) RETURNS numeric LANGUAGE sql STABLE STRICT PARALLEL SAFE AS $$ SELECT total FROM shop.orders WHERE id = p_order $$
CREATE FUNCTION shop.touch() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.placed_at := now(); RETURN NEW; END $$
CREATE TRIGGER orders_touch BEFORE UPDATE ON shop.orders FOR EACH ROW WHEN (OLD.state IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.state) EXECUTE FUNCTION shop.touch()
CREATE STATISTICS shop.orders_customer_state (dependencies) ON customer_id, state FROM shop.orders
COMMENT ON TABLE shop.orders IS 'Orders placed by customers.'
COMMENT ON COLUMN shop.orders.total IS 'Gross amount.'
INSERT INTO shop.customers (email) VALUES ('first@example.test'), ('second@example.test')
INSERT INTO shop.orders (customer_id, total) SELECT id, 10 FROM shop.customers

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customers_pkey ON shop.customers USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_invoice_idx ON shop.orders USING btree (invoice_number) NULLS NOT DISTINCT
CREATE INDEX orders_open_idx ON shop.orders USING btree (customer_id, placed_at DESC) INCLUDE (state) WHERE (state <> 'cancelled'::shop.order_state)

vectors.description: security, PostgreSQL 16: grants and a column grant, row security enabled and forced, permissive and restrictive policies for named roles and the PUBLIC pseudo-role next to a real role named "PUBLIC" (null in a policy's roles, an absent "to" in an ACL entry), a SECURITY DEFINER function with a pinned search_path and EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC, default privileges, an event trigger

roles: DO $do$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'exdb_golden_app') THEN CREATE ROLE exdb_golden_app NOLOGIN; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'exdb_golden_auditor') THEN CREATE ROLE exdb_golden_auditor NOLOGIN; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'PUBLIC') THEN CREATE ROLE "PUBLIC" NOLOGIN; END IF; END $do$
setup: CREATE SCHEMA tenancy
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA tenancy TO exdb_golden_app, exdb_golden_auditor
CREATE TABLE tenancy.documents (id bigint PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id uuid NOT NULL, owner_id uuid NOT NULL, body text, private_note text)
ALTER TABLE tenancy.documents ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE tenancy.documents FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY tenant_read ON tenancy.documents FOR SELECT TO exdb_golden_app USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::uuid)

CREATE POLICY owner_update ON tenancy.documents AS PERMISSIVE FOR UPDATE TO exdb_golden_app USING (owner_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true)::uuid) WITH CHECK (owner_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true)::uuid)
CREATE POLICY has_body ON tenancy.documents AS RESTRICTIVE FOR ALL TO PUBLIC USING (body IS NOT NULL)
CREATE POLICY quoted_public ON tenancy.documents FOR DELETE TO "PUBLIC" USING (false)
GRANT SELECT, UPDATE ON tenancy.documents TO exdb_golden_app
GRANT SELECT ON tenancy.documents TO PUBLIC
GRANT INSERT ON tenancy.documents TO "PUBLIC"
GRANT SELECT (id, tenant_id) ON tenancy.documents TO exdb_golden_auditor
CREATE FUNCTION tenancy.current_tenant() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp AS $$ SELECT current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::uuid $$
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION tenancy.current_tenant() FROM PUBLIC
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION tenancy.current_tenant() TO exdb_golden_app
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA tenancy GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO exdb_golden_auditor
CREATE FUNCTION tenancy.note_ddl() RETURNS event_trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE NOTICE 'ddl'; END $$
CREATE EVENT TRIGGER exdb_golden_note_ddl ON ddl_command_start WHEN TAG IN ('DROP TABLE') EXECUTE FUNCTION tenancy.note_ddl()

CREATE TYPE shop.address AS (street text, city text, postal_code varchar(10))
CREATE SEQUENCE shop.invoice_numbers AS integer START 1000 INCREMENT 5 MINVALUE 1000 MAXVALUE 999999 CACHE 10

CREATE TABLE shop.customers (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, email text NOT NULL UNIQUE, shipping shop.address, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), email_domain text GENERATED ALWAYS AS (split_part(email, '@', 2)) STORED)

CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, customer_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES shop.customers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, state shop.order_state NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new', total shop.positive_amount, invoice_number integer DEFAULT nextval('shop.invoice_numbers'), placed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
ALTER TABLE shop.orders ADD CONSTRAINT orders_total_cap CHECK (total < 1000000) NOT VALID
ALTER SEQUENCE shop.invoice_numbers OWNED BY shop.orders.invoice_number
CREATE INDEX orders_open_idx ON shop.orders (customer_id, placed_at DESC) INCLUDE (state) WHERE state <> 'cancelled'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_invoice_idx ON shop.orders (invoice_number) NULLS NOT DISTINCT
CREATE TABLE shop.events (id bigint NOT NULL, happened_on date NOT NULL, payload jsonb) PARTITION BY RANGE (happened_on)
CREATE TABLE shop.events_2026 PARTITION OF shop.events FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-01-01') TO ('2027-01-01')
CREATE VIEW shop.open_orders WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.total FROM shop.orders o WHERE o.state IN ('new', 'paid')
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW shop.customer_totals AS SELECT customer_id, sum(total) AS total FROM shop.orders GROUP BY customer_id WITH NO DATA
CREATE FUNCTION shop.order_total(p_order bigint) RETURNS numeric LANGUAGE sql STABLE STRICT PARALLEL SAFE AS $$ SELECT total FROM shop.orders WHERE id = p_order $$
CREATE FUNCTION shop.touch() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.placed_at := now(); RETURN NEW; END $$
CREATE TRIGGER orders_touch BEFORE UPDATE ON shop.orders FOR EACH ROW WHEN (OLD.state IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.state) EXECUTE FUNCTION shop.touch()

roles: DO $do$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'exdb_golden_app') THEN CREATE ROLE exdb_golden_app NOLOGIN; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'exdb_golden_auditor') THEN CREATE ROLE exdb_golden_auditor NOLOGIN; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'PUBLIC') THEN CREATE ROLE "PUBLIC" NOLOGIN; END IF; END $do$
setup: CREATE SCHEMA tenancy
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA tenancy TO exdb_golden_app, exdb_golden_auditor
CREATE TABLE tenancy.documents (id bigint PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id uuid NOT NULL, owner_id uuid NOT NULL, body text, private_note text)
ALTER TABLE tenancy.documents ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE tenancy.documents FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY tenant_read ON tenancy.documents FOR SELECT TO exdb_golden_app USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::uuid)

CREATE POLICY owner_update ON tenancy.documents AS PERMISSIVE FOR UPDATE TO exdb_golden_app USING (owner_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true)::uuid) WITH CHECK (owner_id = current_setting('app.user_id', true)::uuid)
CREATE POLICY has_body ON tenancy.documents AS RESTRICTIVE FOR ALL TO PUBLIC USING (body IS NOT NULL)
CREATE POLICY quoted_public ON tenancy.documents FOR DELETE TO "PUBLIC" USING (false)
GRANT SELECT, UPDATE ON tenancy.documents TO exdb_golden_app
GRANT SELECT ON tenancy.documents TO PUBLIC
GRANT INSERT ON tenancy.documents TO "PUBLIC"
GRANT SELECT (id, tenant_id) ON tenancy.documents TO exdb_golden_auditor
CREATE FUNCTION tenancy.current_tenant() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp AS $$ SELECT current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::uuid $$
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION tenancy.current_tenant() FROM PUBLIC
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION tenancy.current_tenant() TO exdb_golden_app
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA tenancy GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO exdb_golden_auditor
CREATE FUNCTION tenancy.note_ddl() RETURNS event_trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE NOTICE 'ddl'; END $$
CREATE EVENT TRIGGER exdb_golden_note_ddl ON ddl_command_start WHEN TAG IN ('DROP TABLE') EXECUTE FUNCTION tenancy.note_ddl()
ALTER TABLE tenancy.documents NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
DROP POLICY has_body ON tenancy.documents
REVOKE SELECT (id, tenant_id) ON tenancy.documents FROM exdb_golden_auditor
ALTER FUNCTION tenancy.current_tenant() SECURITY INVOKER
CREATE FUNCTION tenancy.escalate() RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$ SELECT $$
